dct_title_s: Satellite  detected water extent over Guli District, White Nile State of Sudan as of 4 September 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20210907SDN** This map illustrates satellite detected waters and the related potentially affected croplands as deduced using a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 4 September 2021 over the Guli District, White Nile State of Sudan. In this area, about 80 km2 of croplands appear to be likely affected by the flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
